plot: On Sunday the family takes ten timer photos for the holiday card in the garden, and Bup wants the Dough Bros in the picture for the first time ever; the bros climb from behind Mr. Pot's petunias to the bench, the garden chair and Mom's sweater while sneezes, shut eyes and wind ruin the clicks and flash-shy Crispy freezes at every flash, until with one click left Mia's face falls — the twist: the bread basket she carried out at the start sits empty front and center, she had put them in the photo all along and they climbed out of it; they dive back in, Crispy faces the flash, photo ten is perfect — then Mia whispers over the walkie that a kitten is crying under the porch.

script.title: Can 5 Bros Sneak Into the Family Photo?

beats.say: The camera's clicking, and we're not in a single picture!
Can five bros sneak into the family photo before the last click?
New episode every day. Subscribe so you don't miss what happens next.
Sunday afternoon. Warm sun, last leaves, the whole family in matching sweaters.
Dad set the camera on the wall. Ten clicks. Someone always blinks.
Mia carried our basket out to the blanket. A picnic, I guess.
The bros hopped out and hid behind Mr. Pot's petunias.
Five crumbs in my flowers. Wonderful. Just wonderful.
Flash! Click one. Crispy jumps behind the flowerpot.
That light. It flashes like fire. I don't do well with fire.
Every year, a family photo. Every year, no bread in it.
Not this year. This year the Dough Bros are on the card.
Click four just went. Six clicks left. Move fast.
Bup leads them along the fence toward the family bench.
Click. Dad sneezes. Click. Grandma's eyes are shut.
We're too small! We're behind a leaf! We look like bugs!
Then we go higher. The garden chair right behind Mom.
They climb the chair leg. Pim slips. Lolly grabs his bandage.
I'm fine! Totally fine! Beans bounce! Mostly!
Click. Mom's elbow, half of Dad, and a flying leaf.
Three clicks left. We're running out of photo!
Every flash, my embers jump. I can't climb toward that light.
Then don't look at the light. Look at me. Climb.
Bup pushes Crispy up the chair leg. Crispy is heavy. Very heavy.
I'm charcoal, Bup. I'm basically a tiny brick.
Flash. Crispy freezes. Click. The wind blows Mia's hair over every face.
Two left! Two! I can't count past two when I'm scared!
We made the chair, but Mom's big hair is in the way!
Then over her shoulder. Onto the sweater. Go, go, go!
Lolly's icing sticks to the wool. Bup's crust catches a loose thread.
I'm glued to a sweater. This is not my best angle.
Click nine. Just a sweater with a cookie on it.
One click left. One. And we're still not in it.
Then Mia looks down at the picnic blanket. Her smile drops.
Wait. Why is Mia sad? It's a happy photo.
In front of Mia sits the bread basket. Front and center. Empty.
The basket! She put it there for the photo. For us!
We were in the picture all along. And we climbed out!
Dad's walking back to the camera! Back to the basket! Now!
Five bros slide down, roll across the blanket, and dive in.
The flash is right there. Front row. Facing it.
Look at Mia, not the light. She's the warm one.
Mia sees five little faces pop up. Biggest grin all day.
Flash. Click. The tenth photo.
I didn't flinch. First flash of my life, and I didn't flinch.
Was I smiling? I think my face was screaming.
Pim, your face always screams. It's your style.
Dad checks the screen. Every eye is open. For once.
Next year, put the petunias in the picture. Just saying.
That evening, Mia's walkie crackles from her bedroom.
Something tiny is crying under the porch, she whispers. A kitten.
A kitten? Kittens chase small things. We are small things!
What do you think happens in the next part?
Tell me in the comments.

es.description:
¿Qué crees que pasa en la siguiente parte? Cuéntamelo en los comentarios.
"Cada año, una foto familiar. Cada año, sin pan." — Bup
Diez clics con temporizador para la tarjeta navideña, y los Dough Bros quieren salir por primera vez. Entre estornudos, viento, un suéter y un flash que asusta a Crispy, se les acaban los clics.
#serie #Animación3D #DoughBros

pt.title: 5 bros conseguem entrar na foto da família? 📸 (Ep 34)
pt.description:
O que você acha que acontece na próxima parte? Conta nos comentários.
"Todo ano uma foto de família. Todo ano, nenhum pão nela." — Bup
Dez cliques no temporizador para o cartão de fim de ano, e os Dough Bros querem aparecer pela primeira vez. Entre espirros, vento, um suéter e um flash que assusta o Crispy, os cliques estão acabando.
#série #Animação3D #DoughBros

ar.description:
ماذا تتوقع أن يحدث في الجزء القادم؟ أخبرني في التعليقات.
"كل عام صورة عائلية. وكل عام لا خبز فيها." — باب
عشر لقطات بالمؤقت لبطاقة الأعياد، وDough Bros يريدون الظهور لأول مرة. بين العطس والريح وكنزة صوفية وفلاش يخيف كريسبي، اللقطات تنفد بسرعة.
#مسلسل #رسوم_ثلاثية_الأبعاد #DoughBros

fr.title: 5 bros peuvent-ils se glisser dans la photo de famille ? 📸 (Ep 34)
fr.description:
À ton avis, que se passe-t-il dans la suite ? Dis-le-moi en commentaire.
"Chaque année une photo de famille. Chaque année, pas de pain dedans." — Bup
Dix déclenchements au retardateur pour la carte des fêtes, et les Dough Bros veulent y être pour la première fois. Entre éternuements, vent, un pull et un flash qui effraie Crispy, les photos filent.
#série #Animation3D #DoughBros

ja.title: 5人のブロスは家族写真に忍び込める？ 📸 (Ep 34)
ja.description:
次のパートで何が起きると思う？コメントで教えてね。
「毎年家族写真。毎年パンは写ってない。」— バップ
ホリデーカード用にタイマーで10枚。ドウ・ブロスは初めて写真に写りたい。くしゃみ、風、セーター、そしてクリスピーが怖がるフラッシュ——残りの枚数はどんどん減っていく。
#シリーズ #3Dアニメ #DoughBros

ko.title: 5형제는 가족사진에 몰래 들어갈 수 있을까? 📸 (Ep 34)
ko.description:
다음 편에서 무슨 일이 일어날까요? 댓글로 알려주세요.
"매년 가족사진. 매년 빵은 없어." — 밥
연말 카드용 타이머 사진 10장. 도우 브로스는 처음으로 사진에 나오고 싶어요. 재채기, 바람, 스웨터, 그리고 크리스피를 놀라게 하는 플래시 사이에서 남은 컷이 줄어들어요.
#시리즈 #3D애니메이션 #DoughBros

de.title: Schaffen es 5 Bros aufs Familienfoto? 📸 (Ep 34)
de.description:
Was glaubst du, passiert im nächsten Teil? Schreib es in die Kommentare.
"Jedes Jahr ein Familienfoto. Jedes Jahr ohne Brot." — Bup
Zehn Selbstauslöser-Klicks für die Weihnachtskarte, und die Dough Bros wollen zum ersten Mal mit drauf. Zwischen Niesen, Wind, einem Pullover und einem Blitz, der Crispy erschreckt, gehen die Klicks schnell aus.
#Serie #3DAnimation #DoughBros
